author: Saliousoft
attribution: Photo: Saliousoft, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Plaque_de_la_Rue_Delcasse_%C3%A0_Porto-Novo_au_B%C3%A9nin.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.

author: Adam Jones, Ph.D.
attribution: Photo: Adam Jones, Ph.D., CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Street_Scene_with_Hairdressing_Salon_Sign_-_Abomey_-_Benin.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Small hand-painted hairdresser sign on a metal stand with painted hairstyle portraits, Abomey street. A third line '& T...sse' (probably 'Tresse') is partly hidden by a metal finial and is left out. 'COUTURE' awning and 'POISSONNERIE Billfish' board are distractors.

author: Ji-Elle
attribution: Photo: Ji-Elle, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Parc_national_de_la_Pendjari-Signal%C3%A9tique_(2).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Green directional boards with yellow capitals in Pendjari National Park, park logo on top. Faint painted-over old figures ('17') show behind '7 Km' on the first line; arrows between names and distances not transcribed.

author: Ji-Elle
attribution: Photo: Ji-Elle, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ecole_primaire_publique_de_Bongou_(1).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Painted school sign on two poles in open ground, Atakora. Text is small relative to the frame; the key line is 'BONGOU' beside a left arrow. Accents are omitted on the sign.

author: Ji-Elle
attribution: Photo: Ji-Elle, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Abomey-Palais_du_roi_Houegbadja_(3).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Rusty stencilled board in front of the palace wall in Abomey. Only the two title lines are transcribed; the small historical paragraph below is too faded to read reliably.

author: Brian Kelley from Auggen, Germany
attribution: Photo: Brian Kelley from Auggen, Germany, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hotel_Oceane_Sign_(218265574).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hotel roadside board in Cotonou, shot slightly from below. 'L'Océane' and 'Residence Hôtelière' are script logo text under a dolphin. The small slogan in the blue band at the bottom is left out; an arrow is cut off at the bottom edge.

author: Brian Kelley from Auggen, Germany
attribution: Photo: Brian Kelley from Auggen, Germany, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Door_of_No_Return_Sign_Ouidah_(218406275).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
